messages:
Nina V: working on a bulk-approve flow for eval runs — prototype here: https://figma.com/file/bulk-approve. Behavior: select multiple results -> 'Bulk approve' opens a confirmation modal with progress bar as approvals happen. need copy + a11y review. :clipboard: Cal H: quick pass — big accessibility surface: live-progress announcements, per-item error handling, keyboard cancel, and how focus is managed after the modal closes. Rochelle T: agree. screen readers need both summary and incremental feedback. propose: modal has role=dialog, focus on primary action when opened, and when approvals start we should move focus to a non-modal live region that updates "Approving 3 of 12" but don't re-focus users away from the cancel button. Marco P: also think about long-running batches: include an indeterminate state briefly then switch to determinate when we know total, and expose progress bar semantics with aria-valuemin/max/valuenow. if an item fails, list it in a results panel with links to the diff and make it keyboard-navigable. Nina V: copy question: modal title options: 'Confirm bulk approve' vs 'Approve selected results' vs 'Approve 12 items'. which is clearest? I like including count. Cal H: 'Approve 12 items' is concise and explicit. that helps SR users too. modal primary CTA: 'Approve' or 'Start approving'? maybe 'Approve 12' as the button text to avoid ambiguity. Rochelle T: I prefer 'Approve 12' as CTA. add a secondary 'Cancel' and a tertiary 'Approve and skip errors' is risky — better to handle errors in a follow-up results view. keep modal simple. Marco P: for keyboard flow: 1) open modal -> focus lands on Cancel? No, focus should land on the primary CTA per our modal pattern. 2) after pressing Approve, don't move focus into the progress live region — keep focus on 'Cancel' (which becomes 'Stop') so keyboard users can stop the run. 3) Tab sequence should be: Stop/Cancel -> progress region link -> close. Nina V: good. for SR announcement plan: on start, update polite live region: 'Approving 1 of 12'. increments as each completes. when batch completes announce 'Approved 11 items, 1 failed. See results.' If zero failures, announce 'All 12 items approved.' Keep announcements polite, not assertive. Cal H: implementation snippet suggestion for the progress aria/live: ```html
``` Note: the visible progress bar should not steal focus when updated. The sr-only region drives SR announcements. Rochelle T: add aria-describedby on the modal to point to a short summary explaining what approvals do (e.g., "Approving will mark results as accepted and record audit events"). Also include a link to 'Audit log' in the results panel. Marco P: error handling UX: when an item fails, append a single focusable list item in the results area with text 'Approval failed for Diff 5 — reason: model timeout'. It should have a 'Retry' button and 'Open diff' link. When a failure is added, update polite region with '1 approval failed'. Nina V: keyboard cancel behavior: 'Cancel' becomes 'Stop' once approving starts. pressing Stop triggers a confirmation? maybe not — Stop should halt remaining approvals and show partial results. If Stop is pressed accidentally, Undo is possible via the audit log but not trivial to revert; maybe show a small toast 'Stopped. 5 of 12 approved.' with an Undo for the last item only. Thoughts? Cal H: agree no confirmation on Stop; it should be quick. Add a toast with role=status and an Undo for last action only. Document in acceptance criteria that irreversible bulk actions require audit trail rather than modal confirmations. Rochelle T: accessibility acceptance criteria proposal: 1) Modal is role=dialog with aria-labelledby and aria-describedby. 2) Primary CTA reads 'Approve {count}' and receives initial focus. 3) Progress updates use a polite sr-only live region; visible progress bar uses progressbar role with valuenow/valuemin/valuemax. 4) While running, primary CTA becomes 'Stop' and remains focused; users can Tab to per-item results which appear live. 5) Per-item failures are focusable and announced when added; include clear actionable controls. 6) On completion, announce final summary; focus returns to a sensible place (e.g., results table row 1) and modal closes if behind flag. 7) Keyboard+screen reader test matrix documented (NVDA, JAWS, VoiceOver, VoiceOver iOS). Marco P: add unit/e2e tests: simulate 0/1/partial failures, verify aria-live text updates, ensure Stop halts future network calls, ensure progressbar attributes update. Also add telemetry events for batch_start, batch_stop, batch_complete, per_item_result. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist created: bulk-approve-modal -> role=dialog, aria-labelledby, aria-describedby, polite-live-progress, progressbar-attributes, stop-button-focus, per-item-focusable-errors, results-audit-link, toast-undo-last, SR-test-matrix. See /docs/accessibility/bulk-approve.md :white_check_mark: Nina V: awesome. I'll update the prototype and send a small PR with the modal + sr-only live region + progress semantics. Follow-ups: @Cal H to add unit/e2e tests; @Rochelle T to run SR passes on VoiceOver & NVDA; @Marco P to design results panel for failures. Target: behind feature flag in two sprints. :rocket:
